title: Only 1 in 5 organizations are prepared to move toward autonomous AI agents, Deloitte finds
summary: Only 1 in 5 organizations are prepared to move toward autonomous AI agents, Deloitte finds HR Dive
body: Only 1 in 5 organizations are prepared to move toward autonomous AI agents, Deloitte finds HR Dive
summaryZh: 德勤的一项最新调查显示，只有五分之一的组织准备好向自主AI智能体过渡，反映出企业级落地仍面临挑战。原始信息显示：Only 1 in 5 organizations are prepared to move toward autonomous AI agents, Deloitte finds HR Dive。该消息由HR Dive发布，主题为“Only 1 in 5 organizations are prepared to move toward autonomous AI agents, Deloitte finds”。其重要性主要体现在：德勤研究表明企业在迈向自主AI智能体方面的准备程度较低。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
